header: Billing questions engineers ask before signing
subheadline: Answers on metering, extra pages and batches that fail halfway. For anything else, see the billing reference or open a ticket; we answer the next business day.

question_items.question: What counts as a page?
question_items.answer: One side of a document sent to an endpoint. A 12-page PDF posted to the extraction endpoint counts as 12 pages, whether or not every page returns fields. Blank pages detected during splitting are not billed.

question_items.question: Are failed requests billed?
question_items.answer: No. Requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status are not metered. If a batch stops mid-run, its pages are credited back in the same billing period, without a support ticket.

question_items.question: What happens once the included pages run out?
question_items.answer: Extra pages bill at the plan rate: EUR 0.010 on Build, EUR 0.007 on Scale. The workspace spend cap stops processing at the limit you set, so the invoice cannot keep growing.
